Your profile - You hold at least a Certificate of Competency as Second Engineer < 3000 kW sailing. - You have valid STCW certificates, a medical examination and a seaman's book. - You have solid technical knowledge and experience as a mechanical engineer on board a seagoing vessel. - You are resilient, solution-oriented and have a hands-on mentality. - You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. 
Do you not (yet) meet the requirements, but have a strong interest in tug operations? We offer the opportunity to learn the profession through an (H)WTK apprenticeship programme. This programme consists of on-the-job training, where you will first carry out work under the supervision of experienced colleagues.
